title: Brik Pipeline Report Aggregate v1.1
description: Cross-stage aggregated pipeline report. v1.1 introduces pipeline.context (snapshot vs release) which drives the business filter, pipeline.business (overall outcome derived from per-stage business.status), and summary.business (counts of success / warning / error across stages). The legacy summary.warnings array is removed: warnings now live as business.status=warning on individual fragments. See chantier docs/chantiers/20260510_tech-business-orthogonal-axes.md.

pipeline.description: Pipeline-level metadata: identity, provenance, timing, overall status, and the v1.1 business outcome.

id.description: CI pipeline identifier (string for portability across platforms).

url.description: Direct URL to the pipeline view, when the platform exposes one.

platform.description: CI platform that ran the pipeline.

commit.description: Git commit metadata. Optional; populated by init when available. Presence of commit.tag flips pipeline.context to 'release'.

repo_url.description: Browseable HTTPS URL of the source repository, captured by init from CI_PROJECT_URL (GitLab), GIT_URL (Jenkins), or 'git config remote.origin.url' as a fallback. Credentials are stripped and SSH forms are converted to HTTPS. Used by the HTML renderer to build deep links to commits, branches and tags on the hosting forge (GitLab, GitHub, Gitea, Bitbucket).

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset, recorded at pipeline start.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset, recorded by report.aggregate_fragments or report.render.

status.description: Technical pipeline status: 'failed' if any fragment has status=failed, 'skipped' if all stages were skipped, 'success' otherwise. Read for technical analysis; see business.status for the user-facing verdict.

context.description: Pipeline execution context. 'release' when the run carries a git tag (commit.tag non-null); 'snapshot' otherwise. Drives the business filter (snapshot is lenient, release is strict) and the continue_on_error default.

business.description: Pipeline-level business outcome, computed from per-stage business.status values. error if any stage is error; warning if any stage is warning and no error; success otherwise.

triggered_by.description: Origin of the pipeline run: a user identifier, 'push', 'schedule', 'manual', etc.

notify.description: Notification dispatch metadata, injected by stages.notify after the aggregate is built. Surfaces which channels were configured at run time, the policy each one used (BRIK_NOTIFY_*_ON), whether the policy matched this run, and the pipeline gatekeeper decision. Absent in pre-notify-v2 archives; renderers must treat it as optional.

channels.description: Per-channel configuration snapshot. Order matches the dispatch order in stages.notify (slack, email, webhook).

configured.description: True when the channel trigger env var (BRIK_NOTIFY_SLACK_CHANNEL / BRIK_NOTIFY_EMAIL_TO / BRIK_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_URL) is set at run time.

on.description: Dispatch policy: BRIK_NOTIFY_*_ON. Defaults to 'always' when the channel is configured without an explicit policy.

would_send.description: True when the channel was configured and the policy matched the pipeline outcome for this run, regardless of any delivery error. Captures intent, not delivery confirmation.

gatekeeper.description: Final pipeline outcome decision derived by stages.notify from pipeline.business.status. 'fail' when business_status is 'error'; 'pass' otherwise.

stages.description: Array of per-stage fragments, one per executed stage. Order matches CI stage order. Each item validates against the v1.1 fragment schema (carries the typed business block).

summary.description: Cross-stage aggregated metrics. v1.1 closes additionalProperties to lock the contract; new summary blocks require a schema bump. summary.warnings is removed (legacy form replaced by per-stage business.reason).

business.description: Stage outcome counts (business axis). Sums per-stage business.status values across the stages array.

security.description: Cross-stage security signal: critical findings per scanner and total vulnerabilities.

test.description: Test summary projected from the test fragment's business payload.

artifacts.description: Build artefact summary projected from package and deploy fragments.

policy.description: Findings management policy snapshot for this run.

proof.description: Optional proof envelope: hash of the report itself, links to retained artefacts, signature flag. v1.1 inherits the v1.0 contract; supply-chain signing remains a Phase 4 concern.
